message: Hi Alex, it's Marcus at Luna Hair Studio, interesting. What does this cost?
reply: Hi Marcus, thanks for writing back. The fix pack is a flat $900 one-time to resolve whatever issues we find in the audit (speed, broken links, mobile display, etc.). After that, an optional $250/month care plan covers ongoing monitoring and small updates if you want it. No pressure either way. Want me to send the audit findings first?
